full_assessment.summary: This product contains moderate-risk additives (Dextrose, Farine de pois • chiches (Pea and Chickpea Flour)). Consume in moderation.

moderate_risk.name: Dextrose
moderate_risk.micro_report: **  A simple sugar (glucose). Excessive consumption contributes to weight gain, increased risk of type 2 diabetes, and potential cardiovascular issues.  Moderation is key.  [Source:  American Heart Association guidelines on added sugar intake]. [1][2]

moderate_risk.name: Farine de pois • chiches (Pea and Chickpea Flour)
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** While generally safe, individuals with legume allergies must avoid these.  Allergic reactions can range from mild to severe (anaphylaxis). [Source:  WHO guidelines on food allergies]. [3][4]

low_risk.name: Epices moulues (Ground spices)
low_risk.micro_report: **  Generally safe, though specific spice profiles may vary in antioxidant or other bioactive properties.
